name: ksf-pharmacy
description: KSF Pharmacy Management System — multi-pharmacy SaaS for Pakistan. React + TypeScript client, Express + TypeScript API, MongoDB.

scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.test: node --import tsx --import ./tests/setup.mjs --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/unit.test.mjs tests/api.test.mjs tests/accounting.test.mjs tests/live.test.mjs tests/stripe.test.mjs tests/plans.test.mjs tests/directory.test.mjs tests/access.test.mjs tests/platform-accounts.test.mjs tests/scanning.test.mjs tests/selling-gst-loan.test.mjs tests/wallet-insights.test.mjs tests/security.test.mjs
scripts.test:api: node --import tsx --import ./tests/setup.mjs --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/api.test.mjs tests/accounting.test.mjs tests/live.test.mjs tests/stripe.test.mjs tests/plans.test.mjs tests/directory.test.mjs tests/access.test.mjs tests/platform-accounts.test.mjs tests/scanning.test.mjs tests/selling-gst-loan.test.mjs tests/wallet-insights.test.mjs tests/security.test.mjs
